g.text: Area 500 000 km² imaged once. (b) 30 m cells (5.6 × 10⁸ cells) and 90 % detection probability per look. Assumes false alarms independent
between cells and looks; real clutter (clouds, shadows, seasons, misregistration) is correlated, so measured rates are needed.
